_comment: Exceptions of scripts/check-english.py: the only places where text in another language than English is expected. Paths are relative to the repository's root; '**' crosses folders, '*' does not. Every entry says why. The values of locale keys ({ en = ..., fr = ... }, {"fr": ...}) are translations and are never checked.

skip.why: This check's own word lists and exceptions.

strings.why: Texts the service sends to players (forms, refusals, e-mails, decisions) in English and French, the protocol's localized strings (their comments are still checked).
Checks the French texts of the password forms.

comments.why: The installer asks its questions in English or French (--lang): only its comments are checked, since its texts nest quotes in ways the string detection cannot follow.

lines.why: Test of a non-ASCII member name.
Test of a display name in UTF-8.
Test of an oversized non-ASCII input.
